items.title: Add deterministic gitRoot repair UX for wrapper-root projects
items.context: When metadataRoot is a non-git wrapper and exactly one nested child git repo exists, config diagnostics should suggest an explicit gitRoot repair command. The repair command must require explicit --set-git-root plus --confirm, validate the target is a git-backed repo under metadataRoot, write only the config field, and leave ambiguous multi-repo layouts fail-closed. Do not spawn host agents or silently choose a signed workspace.
items.userSees: For a wrapper root with one child repo, lattice config doctor reports gitRoot=child as an explicit repair suggestion; lattice config repair --set-git-root=child --confirm writes lattice.config.json and subsequent story_resolve/review_run_start can resolve the signed workspace.
